newsitem.title: USA: Sept S&P 500 futures extend rally after bond close.
newsitem.headline: Sept S&P 500 futures extend rally after bond close.

text.p: July 16 - September S&P 500 stock index futures continued their daylong ascent after the 1400 CDT close of Treasury bond futures trade, rumbling to another all-time high at 943.90. Treasury bond futures closed 24/32 higher at 114-22/32, just off the day's high of 114-27/32, after the benchmark 30-year cash bond pushed below the key 6.50 pct yield level.
